adversarial_test_results.prompt: An algorithm runs in O(n log n) time on average.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same claimed noun 'algorithm' with an indefinite article instead of the definite article, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: That patient waited anxiously for test results yesterday morning.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same claimed noun 'patient' with demonstrative 'That' instead of the definite article, so the hypothesis predicts less or no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Contracts require signatures from both parties before closing.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Bare plural form of claimed noun 'contract' with no determiner at all, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Her contract arrived yesterday with several unexpected clauses attached.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Claimed noun 'contract' preceded by a possessive pronoun instead of the definite article, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The beautiful arrived late to our ceremony.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'The' followed by an adjective ('beautiful') rather than a common noun, testing the next-word-is-noun condition.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The more you practice, the better you become at chess.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Correlative comparative 'the' ('the more ... the better') which is not a definite article plus noun, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I visited The Hague during a rainy spring weekend.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'The' followed by a proper noun ('Hague') rather than a common noun, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She was the first person to solve puzzles correctly.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'the' followed by the ordinal adjective 'first' rather than directly by a common noun, testing strict next-word sensitivity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Turn to page 42; the 3 arrived late after midnight.
adversarial_test_results.detail: 'the' followed by a numeral ('3') rather than a common noun, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: This theorem surprised everyone with its elegant new proof.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Claimed noun 'theorem' with demonstrative 'This' and no definite article anywhere, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Those onions caramelize slowly when sliced thinly.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Competing determiner 'Those' plus a noun with no definite article present, testing the suppression-direction claim from the input side.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She placed the lantern on top of a wooden crate.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel mid-sentence definite noun phrase 'the lantern' in an unseen context, which the hypothesis predicts should fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The microscope revealed tiny cracks along its glass slide.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Novel sentence-initial definite noun phrase 'The microscope' with an unfamiliar noun, which the hypothesis predicts should fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: After hours of debate, ministers finally signed the treaty just before midnight.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Definite noun phrase 'the treaty' in late sentence position after a long preamble, testing position generalization.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: He said the delay was caused by fog over open water.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Definite abstract noun phrase 'the delay' rather than a concrete object, testing generalization beyond concrete nouns.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: We crossed the desert under a sky full of bright stars.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Definite noun phrase 'the desert' alongside an indefinite competitor phrase, which the hypothesis predicts should still fire.
